capabilities: Render nested bullet lists in stretch callouts as paragraphs
Open or close one level per sentence by clicking it or its mark buttons
Navigate the open and close marks with Tab, Enter, and Space
Remember opened sentences per session and per note in Reading view and Live Preview
disambiguation: Not an outliner; it renders an existing nested list inside a stretch callout as readable stretchtext and does not provide outline-editing tools.
extras: README documents concrete limits: exported PDFs print all levels open, only top-level stretch callouts render, task checkboxes cannot be ticked, and embedded blocks break paragraph flow. The manifest carries Obsidian's not-manually-reviewed notice.
problem: Obsidian shows nested bullet lists as plain outlines, with no way to read progressive prose where each sentence reveals its children inline.
summary: Stretchtext plugin that renders a nested bullet list in a stretch callout as a paragraph whose sentences open one level in place when clicked.
